book.name: Suun
book.title: Mɓe ɗe Jesu Kristi woo nJoon ndǝǝn Suun

content: Aɓwoon ɗese, ɓǝ nghan naa mee ngulepnaan npoo kǝ sham nɗǝǝn ɗengnaan. Ngulepnaan ɗesǝ wur kǝ iiko ɗeɗes zam. Mɓǝ peeɓang mǝ iiko wur nǝ ɓang yil nǝ kǝdǝng.
Shi ɗoo ɗeɗes ɓe wur le or:

content.text: <<Ɓal fi kǝ kyes! Ɓal fi kǝ kyes!
Kǝ koo a luwa ɗeɗang ɗe nyakkap.
Mɓeeɗe gyet gurum nyil mo shini-shini, gyet mo shwaa a am anab
gyet mo cin ngaa kǝ war
moo long a shi lǝɓet mbǝ bii
kǝ kat war ɗe mǝ yil ɗese, ɗe nǝ met mǝ sat.>>

content: Kar Bǝ Dyeel ƊeNǝ Mbǝ Taa nBabilon

content.text: Ɗangɓe wen kǝlǝng mee ɗoo npoo
ɗe nǝ put nɗǝǝn ɗengnaan, nǝ sat nǝnee,
mɓekǝ taji mo cin kwat nwun ashak kǝ war mbǝ shikbish war nǝ mo kas,
Mɓekǝ taji wu lap memee nɗǝǝn jeel war nǝ mo kas.
Mbǝɗǝ shikbish war nǝ mo kǝ ak
kǝ mbii ɗǝ war kǝ cin wun,
mbǝ mbii ɗe gyet war kǝ cin mo nwun.
Wu ɗoo mo yitvǝl, kaaɗe gyet
Wu yit kǝ kwat ɗe nǝ a mǝ kar kǝ jeel
ɗe war lap nǝ, nǝ ɗee nciit-nciit kǝ ram kǝ long ɗe gyet war shin nkáa war,
mɓeeɗe war nkaa ɗyeep kaa nnee
<wen a mishkoom ɗe mat. baa wen a matkaa,
Mɓemǝnǝ ɓe, jeel war nǝ mo njì taa
nkaa war ndi mman, mɓeeɗi a parpuus mǝndong,
ɓe muut kǝ maap, kǝ neen, mo ntaa nkaa war.

content: <<Katɗang mishkoom mǝ ɓǝm-yil ɗesǝ mo, ɗe gyet mo cin ngaa ashak kǝ war, ɗe gyet mo se pak long war nǝ mo ashak kǝ war, ɓe mo nnaa ɗyeel ɗe nǝ caan war, ɓe mo nwal kǝ maap mbǝ war.
Mbee jeel ɗeɗes ɗe war shwaa nǝ. Ɓe kǝǝrmuut nyaa mo, mbǝ mo nɗar a jong-jong kǝ moo wal ɗǝ, kǝ mo nsat nǝnee,

content.text: Yil ɗe gyet wii kǝ iiko ɗes,
ɓe kyes fii nǝ jì wul!>>

content: <<Nennwer ɗe mo ɓǝm-yil nǝ mo, mo nwal kǝ maap nkaa war, mbǝɗe baa mee ngwe kuɗi, nseet lée mo mo kas.

Lée nwar ɗe mo a zinariya mo, kǝ mǝ azurfa mo, kǝ mǝ nghǝk ɗeret ɗe moo mǝlep nyilaknyilak, kǝ nlǝr ɗe rǝret mo shini-shini, kǝ nlǝr ɗe pan a naat mo, kǝ shiyeep ɗeret mo, kǝ mbii ɗe mo ɗak mo a shi oos nǝ mo, kǝ shiyeep ɗekǝrǝm mo, kǝ mbǝɗe mo ɗak mo a shi shool ɗeret mo, kǝ nghǝk ɗeret ɗe mǝ ɗyiklu mo,

kǝ bii ɗe kǝ toos shangshang, kaa sinamon, kǝ le shǝta, meer, kǝ frankisens, kǝ mwoor ɗe gurum kǝ caan, mbǝkǝ wur kǝlǝng toos ɗeshang nǝ ɗe sǝ, kǝ mǝ am anab, kǝ mǝ mwoor paat, kǝ mǝ áas ɗeret mo, mǝ alkama, kǝ mǝ randong mo, kǝ tǝm mo, kǝ mǝ bǝring mo, kǝ mǝ keke bǝring, kǝ gurum mo ɗi mo sǝrep mo kaa kǝrem mo sǝ>>

content.text: Nennwer nǝ mo nsat nwar nǝnee,
<<Jir mbii ɗi rǝret ɗe ɗi yii leyit nkaa mo,
kǝ rak fii nǝ mo jir,

content: Nennwer ɗe mo seet kǝ mbii ɗesǝ mo, ɗe mo kat long pǝ war di, mo nɗar jong-jong, kǝ kǝǝrmuut fes yaa mo, mbǝ shwaajeel ɗe war nkaa shwaa nǝ mo nwal kǝ maap.

content.text: <<Jeel fii, jeel fii, wii yil ɗǝɗes,
gyet yam, ɓe wii yii jwal a lee mulki ɗi rǝret mo
ɗetap piyaa mo, kǝ ɗetap naat juwal mo.
ɓǝ long fii ɗeɗes sǝ mo ɗee a ɗebuu!>

content: Jir nentung tii am mo, kǝ gurum ɗe moo ghǝr mo ntii nǝ mo, kǝ nen ɗe moo kat mbii teer mo mo a nɗǝǝn baahar mo, das ɗesǝ mo jir, mo nɗar jong-jong, kǝ war.
Katɗang mo nnaa ɗyeel mǝ caan war nǝ kàa, ɓe mo nfwo or shiɓal nǝnee, <Baa mo cam kat mee yil ɗeɗes kaa yil sǝ kas.>
Mo kok yil le nkaa káa mo mo, ashak kǝ wal, kǝ maap nǝnee,

content.text: <<Jeel fii! Jeel fii, wii yil ɗeɗes,
ɗe mo kǝ tii mo nkaa baahar,
moo kat long a mbǝ long fii,
mbǝ mbii ɗe nǝ kat yil ɗesǝ war.
Wu cin retnyit, wun nen Naan mo,
kǝ wun jeplep mo, kǝ nensatpwoo Naan mo,

content: Ɗangɓe mee ngulep Naan ɗeɓal, wur mang mee nghǝk ɗeɗes kaa fin ɗyees ɗak sǝ, wur vwet nǝ nɗǝǝn am baahar, kǝ wur sat nǝnee,

content.text: kǝ naa war ɗe zak kas.
Baa mo mbaa kǝlǝng wal kǝ ndeng-ndeng, kǝ ɗoo nenkook mo,
kǝ wal mɓel, kǝ wal nfeer mo nɗǝǝn wii Babilon kas.
Baa mo nwaa kat mee ngucìn ɗak shi sar,
mǝ koo a kaan ɗak ɗeɗangyi nɗǝǝn wa kas.
Baa mee wus ngyem nwaa baa ɓangpee ɗi nɗǝǝn wii kas.
Baa mo waa baa kǝlǝng mee ɗoo mǝshpwoo kǝ matpoo nɗǝǝn wii kas.
Gyet yam, ɓe nennwer fii nǝ mo, a nen ɗǝnan-nan mǝ yil nǝ mo.
Gyet a shi mulgut mǝ soot fii,
ɓe yii le gurum ɗe mo ndǝǝn yil nǝ mo jir,
mo taa mer ar ɗi buu.
kǝ toom mǝ nen Naan mo, kǝ toom mǝ gurum
ɗe gyet mo saa mo jir nɗǝǝn ɓǝm-yil nǝ.>>
